reason: Clearing debris at the wound seems like a useful start to repair.
expectation: Phagocytes will engulf debris around the sealed vessel, preparing the wound for healing.

alternatives.reason: Repair signals may help establish blood supply, but I chose to start with cleanup.

effect: The wound is cleaned around the clot, so I can move on to supporting repair.
reaction: The cleanup was predictable, but it made the first stage clear.
reason: Repair signals may help the nearby capillary supply the healing tissue.
expectation: The signals will stimulate a blood vessel response near the wound, possibly new capillary growth.

alternatives.reason: Fibroblasts and nutrients could build the supporting matrix, but I chose to establish blood supply first.

effect: The repair signals produced a new vessel branch connected to the circulation, giving me a way to add it to the wound.
reaction: The connected sprout makes the blood-supply step clear.
reason: Adding the sprout to the cleaned wound should support the healing tissue.
expectation: The wound will gain a growing blood vessel to help supply repair.

alternatives.reason: Fibroblasts could build supporting tissue, but I want to connect the new vessel first.

effect: The wound now has connected capillary branches and separate surface and support slots to fill.
reaction: The two slots make the remaining repair work clear.
reason: Fibroblasts and matrix nutrients seem suited to building the wound's supporting layer.
expectation: The fibroblasts will produce a supporting matrix that can be added to the healing skin.

alternatives.reason: The edge cells could help close the surface, but I chose to build support first.

effect: The fibroblasts made new connective tissue, which appears ready to fill the wound's support slot.
reaction: The collagen fibres make the role of the fibroblasts clear.
reason: Add the new connective tissue to support the healing skin.
expectation: The connective tissue will fill the support slot in the wound.

alternatives.reason: The edge cells could help close the surface, but I want to add the support I just made first.

effect: The wound has new collagen-rich support, though the tissue is not yet as strong as uninjured skin.
reaction: The distinction between closing the wound and regaining strength is useful.
reason: This is the only available combination, and the edge cells appear needed to close the surface.
expectation: The cells will grow or spread into a new surface layer that can be added to the wound.

effect: The edge cells formed a new surface that can fill the remaining wound slot.
reaction: The picture clearly shows how the surface closes across the gap.
reason: The only available combination fits the new surface onto the healing skin.
expectation: The new surface will close the wound over its supporting tissue.

effect: The wound surface is closed and supported, but the deeper tissue is still gaining strength; the temporary clot remains to be cleared.
reaction: The reminder that strength returns later makes the repair feel less instantaneous.
reason: The only available combination addresses the remaining goal of clearing the temporary clot.
expectation: The enzymes will break down the clot as the wound continues to heal.

effect: The temporary clot has mostly been cleared, while the scar remains and its collagen continues to change. Both goals are complete.
reaction: The still-maturing scar makes the ending feel more realistic than an instant return to uninjured skin.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the new connective tissue was worthwhile because it connected fibroblasts and collagen to support beneath the wound, while explaining that the tissue is still weak.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and then fitting the new surface felt predictable, especially with only one combination offered at each step, though the picture clearly showed the cells crossing the gap.

surprise.text: The distinction between a closed wound and deeper tissue that is still gaining strength made me think of repair as continuing after closure.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. The offered combinations and wound slots made their intended roles clear, although the menu supplied compatibility rather than leaving it to discover.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in another chapter if it explored another connected process; the repair sequence was clear, but the later choices felt quite directed.
